course_name_en:
MDB4011 
— Introduction to German Language Skills

learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to read and understand simple texts (Reading).
Students will be able to write letters with simple sentences and introduce themselves and others (Writing).
Students will be able to listen to and understand basic daily conversations; introduce and express themselves and others with simple sentences (Listening and Speaking).
Students will be able to recognize and use beginner-level vocabulary related to daily life (Vocabulary Knowledge).
Students will gain independent study skills by completing internet assignments using technology and access all course materials via Moodle (Technology Use).

syllabus_topics: Unit 1: Me and you (Ich und du) - Introductions, formal vs. informal address, alphabet, verb conjugations, sentence stress, listening exercises
Unit 1: Me and you (Ich und du) - Numbers (1 to 100), creating classroom dialogues, forming question structures, listening exercises, workbook exercises (pp. 78-83)
Unit 2: In the German course (Im Deutschkurs) - Course dialogues, classroom objects and materials, articles, negative structure "kein", personal pronouns, "to be" verb, 'v' pronunciation in words
Unit 2: In the German course (Im Deutschkurs) - Question and answer structures, creating word cards, verb conjugations, question sentences, listening exercises, workbook exercises (pp. 84-89)

Unit 3: This is me (Das bin ich) - Personal information, travel preparations, professions, stating location, survey: languages spoken in the course, verbs (accusative) - brauchen / haben, adjectives, negative structure "nicht", use of "sein" (to be) in the past tense, long / short vowel pronunciation, listening exercises

Unit 3: This is me (Das bin ich) - Stating location, survey: languages spoken in the course, negative structure "nicht", use of "sein" (to be) in the past tense, listening exercises, workbook exercises (pp. 90-95)

Unit 4: In the market (Auf dem Markt) - Shopping, prices, numbers (100 - 
…), plural forms of words, 'ö/ü' pronunciation
Unit 4: In the market (Auf dem Markt) - Statistics, asking a neighbor something, salad party, use of personal pronouns with accusative case, listening exercises, workbook exercises (pp. 96-101)
Unit 5: My family and I (Meine Familie und ich) - Family photos, my child is sick, possessive pronouns, "mögen" verb, 'ei' pronunciation within words
Unit 6: Time concepts throughout the year (Viel Zeit im Jahr) - Seasons and months, weather, words describing weather, use of "es", simple past tense, listening exercises
Unit 6: Time concepts throughout the year (Viel Zeit im Jahr) - Clocks, weather forecasts, adverbs of time, prepositions: im/um, listening exercises, workbook exercises (pp. 108-113)
Unit 7: From early to late (Von früh bis spät) - How a day passes, date expressions and working hours, separable verbs, adverbs of time, 'h' pronunciation within words, listening exercises
Unit 7: From early to late (Von früh bis spät) - Planning for the weekend, prepositions: am / von … bis, listening exercises, workbook exercises (pp. 114-119)
